issue_breakdown.label: Zero Recall / False Misses on Existing Photos

zero_recall.quote: Always demonstrating to people how easy it was to find a photo i.e. 'Dog in a hat'. Now the search has changed to AI and it's terrible. Even changing to classic, the same search will show your photo briefly, then change to 'Nothing found' or a huge list of random garbage.

If in a few years you want to find "that photo of me you took on the beach in north carolina", with a quick search you can. There are annoying limitations though... google photos has no idea what the "outer banks" are... and returns no results.

9 out of 10 of my searches results in "No Results" found. Only the most basic and broad searches work. If you search for "Dog", you will get some results, but if you search for "Big Dog", you will get No Results.

literal_keyword.quote: wanted to try to find a remembered example of using Ground Penetrating Radar to find hidden roads in Northern Spain and Southern France, yet for everything tried I could not get Google to actually return results that would ever focus on what it was I actually wanted.

when searching for key words, it gave the option for "most recent" or "best match", that is still there but under most recent it showed searched key words and organized it by date. I have to now pinch zoom x2 for it to break down into chronological order.

Plus figuring out how to word intuitive thought into what AI needs to find photos & still receive less accurate results. You can switch Classic and Gemini but, even Classic is affected to the point that it's less accurate.

"Waterloo patios with friendname" - me looking for when I last saw that person remembering it was on a patio. "Driveway or sidewalk" "cottage docks" "receipts" "Memes with Ted Cruz fleeing to Mexico"
